scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
other_conditions: Local statutory bodies, Apex cooperative societies and National level Apex societies (registered under society or trust act) are eligible as implementing agencies
Producer companies supported by the Office of the District Handicrafts are eligible
Implementing agencies must have a minimum audited annual turnover of Rs. 1.5 crore in each of the last three consecutive years, except for Central/State government agencies
Implementation is limited to agencies that can provide land contribution as required
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹8 crore per unit (with 40% each from O/o DC‑HC and DC‑HL and 20% from the implementing agency) and renovation assistance up to ₹2.5 crore, along with required land contribution.
documents_required: Self‑attested documents related to past Haat‑Bazaar exhibitions attended in the last five years
Details of assistance/support for the exhibition
